reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. ¡Qué alegría tenerte por acá! Con muchísimo gusto te ayudo a armar tu plan. 🌊

🌊 *Buceamos en las Islas del Rosario* (Parque Nacional Corales del Rosario), a 45–60 min en lancha desde Cartagena: aguas cálidas, arrecifes y mucha vida marina. Te resumo las opciones:

🆕 *¿Nunca has buceado?* → el *Minicurso de buceo* (bautismo): teoría, práctica en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor. Desde los 10 años.

🤿 *¿Ya eres buzo certificado?* → *paquetes de inmersiones*: 2 buceos en 1 día, o planes multi-día (4, 5, 7 o 9 buceos).

🎓 *¿Quieres sacarte el título?* → *cursos PADI*: Open Water (el básico), Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades.

🐠 Y si prefieres sin bucear, el *snorkel* es una chulada para ver el arrecife desde la superficie.

¿Cuál te llama? Si quieres te armo la reserva. 😄

Si tu pregunta era sobre algo más concreto que esto, cuéntamelo con más detalle y te confirmo con exactitud. 🙂

msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hello! Great plan to complete your PADI Open Water with a refresher first — that will help you feel confident and safe before the certification dives.

For the 2-day Open Water Referral Course from Cartagena, the price per person is 474 USD online (with the 10% booking discount) or 526 USD regular. This course includes 4 certification dives, boat transport, lunch on day 1, equipment, and your PADI certification.

For the refresher, we recommend the Dive Mini Course, which is 183 USD online or 204 USD regular per person. It’s a 1-day course with theory review, pool session, and 1 open-water dive.

Since you want the mini course the day before the referral, that would be 1 day for the refresher and then 2 days for the referral course.

Does this sound good to you? Also, are you planning to stay overnight on the islands for the referral course or return to Cartagena each day? That affects the logistics and lunch inclusion. Let me know!

Where would you be departing from? We can pick you up *from Cartagena* or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?

Perfect! For convenience, our dive base is located at two hotels on Isla Grande: Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso. Staying at either one means direct pick-up for your dives.

Other hotels with boat access nearby are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao. Accommodation is booked directly with the hotels.

Where would you be departing from? We can pick you up *from Cartagena* or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

About the refresher course: the refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course, which costs 183 USD online or 655,000 COP online (the $50 you mentioned might be a different rate, but our official price is this). It includes theory review, pool session, and one open-water dive.

You can book and pay for the Dive Mini Course on our website here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en
